name: google-workspace-mcp
description: Multi-account Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs and Sheets for Claude. Every call must name the account; writes are audited and file access is confined. macOS and Linux.

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console (ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com).

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret from the same OAuth client. Stored by Claude Desktop, not in a file you edit.

accounts_index_path.title: Accounts index (optional)
accounts_index_path.description: Path to an existing accounts_index.json to reuse the accounts you already authorized. Leave blank to start a separate list in ~/.claude/google-workspace-mcp/.
